name: EvoDeFi MasterChef updatePower raises power without settling rewardDebt
summary: MasterChef.updatePower(pid) is public and recomputes the caller's power from its stake and current NFT bonus without paying pending rewards or resetting rewardDebt, so the next claim pays the added power times the pool's entire accumulated reward per power. Attackers staked, raised their NFT bonus, called updatePower and claimed.
notes: The anchor is the first power-raising updatePower (a 9% NFT bonus on a tiny WBNB stake, realised in its follow-up claims); the loss comes from the June flash-loan transaction by another attacker. Direct calls and contract-mediated Deposit/Withdraw transactions to block 8.4M show no other power-raising calls.
updatePower reads only the pool's totalPower and the caller's bonus, so pool listings, allocation and emission changes are not resets; the proxy bonus source was fixed in the MasterChef constructor.
GEN is valued at the 1,331.58 BNB the attacker realised selling it (WBNB price at the sales), since its sales crashed GEN (rule 15).
